description: C2: the Broken Warden asleep in the breach of the old toll-keep's north wall - a world boss held by his territory (world.aldmere.warden_territory, TitanTerritory: a giant he sees only discovers the keep; a blow, or a giant walking into the keep's yard, wakes him; he hunts to 115 m of the yard and walks home whole). An arena encounter (no leash), its seat reserved within 160 m (reserve_seat; not 300 as Stoneback's: Fort Aldmere's east wall is 280 m off and the war camp's edge 207 m, and his seat would crowd their garrisons out of the budget; 160 m holds the road below the keep, 110 m off) and his AI at the near tier within 400 m (lod_near_m), as Stoneback's and the Rootwarden's. He dies once (persist_death; forbids his outcome flag). The toll fort's garrison (activation 110 m of its centre, 240 m away) and the war camp (150 m of its centre, 210 m away) never see his fight.
